answer: Each claim must climb a mesa of three terraces before it pays. Every terrace demands a jade seal: a stranger-signed receipt for a finished job, stamped with the epoch's fresh random jade value, so no seal can be forged or reused. The fee triples for each extra claim from one funding cluster, so the k-th clone pays 3 to the k while one honest agent pays once. A violet lottery audits one claim in ten, demanding the full job transcript; a failed audit burns the bond and all terrace fees. Claims sharing a payer stack on one step and split a single share, so n clones pay n fees for one payout.
